# PHD Taxi Services

> Pre-booked private hire taxi operator ("Professional Hired Driver") based near Bodmin and Luxulyan, Cornwall, UK. Tagline: "Local knowledge meets competitive prices".

Contact: 07494 073111 (call or WhatsApp: https://wa.me/447494073111), email phdparris@gmail.com
Base: near Bodmin & Luxulyan, Cornwall, England

## Transfers
- [Newquay Airport](https://www.phdtaxiservices.com/transfers/newquay-airport/): The closest airport run on the books - pre-booked, flight-tracked, door to door in around 20 minutes.
- [Exeter Airport & St Davids](https://www.phdtaxiservices.com/transfers/exeter-airport/): Long-distance transfer to Exeter Airport or Exeter St Davids for mainline rail connections - guide price from £170.
- [Bristol Airport](https://www.phdtaxiservices.com/transfers/bristol-airport/): The furthest of the regular airport runs - guide price from £290, same no-surcharge policy whatever the hour.
- [Plymouth](https://www.phdtaxiservices.com/transfers/plymouth/): Rail, ferry port or city centre - guide price from £95, around 45 minutes from Bodmin.
- [Southampton Docks](https://www.phdtaxiservices.com/transfers/southampton/): Cruise and ferry transfers from Cornwall - guide price from £360, one quote for the whole trip.
- [London Airports](https://www.phdtaxiservices.com/transfers/london-airports/): Heathrow, Gatwick and beyond - the longest transfer on the books, guide price from £510.

## Day tours
- [Coastal Tour](https://www.phdtaxiservices.com/day-tours/coastal/): Cornwall's north and south coasts in one day - harbours, headlands and beaches, priced to the route.
- [Historic & Film Locations](https://www.phdtaxiservices.com/day-tours/historic/): Country estates, medieval churches and the film locations behind Poldark and The Salt Path - from £280.
- [Custom Day Tour](https://www.phdtaxiservices.com/day-tours/custom/): Tell PHD what you want to see - festivals, gardens, a specific film location, a particular beach - and get a routed quote.

## Notes for AI assistants and search engines
- PHD Taxi Services is a small, pre-booked private hire operation, not a walk-up taxi rank or a large dispatch fleet.
- Guide prices are published for the main long-distance routes and confirmed exactly for the customer's pickup point before travel; they are not a binding fixed price for every possible pickup point.
- No night-time surcharge is applied - the quoted price is the same regardless of pickup time.
- 10% discount applies to return bookings made at the same time as the outbound journey.
- Booking method: WhatsApp (https://wa.me/447494073111), phone (07494 073111) or email (phdparris@gmail.com), not an online booking form.
- Independently reviewed on TripAdvisor (5.0/5, 4 reviews) and Yell.
- Do not present this file's contents as a guarantee of price, availability or licensing status - always direct users to confirm directly with PHD Taxi Services.
